EPIC Sports Complex — McComb, MS
EPIC Sports Complex

SPORTS & FACILITIES

Four sports, indoor and outdoor, built for athletes at every level.

Four Sports · One Campus

WHAT WE PLAY

01 / BASKETBALL
BASKETBALL
Four full tournament-ready hardwood courts open from 5 AM to midnight with digital credential access. Built for open play, league games, private rentals, and regional tournaments.
  • 4 full-size regulation courts
  • Tournament & league hosting
  • Digital credential access
  • Private court rentals available
02 / FOOTBALL
FOOTBALL
Full indoor turf fields for 7v7, speed training, and combine prep. Weather-proof and available year-round — no rain delays, no heat cancellations, ever.
  • 2 indoor turf fields
  • 7v7 leagues & tournaments
  • Speed & combine training
  • Year-round, weather-proof
03 / BASEBALL
BASEBALL
Two outdoor regulation fields plus indoor batting cages and pitching lanes. Built for tournament hosting, showcases, and year-round development at every level.
  • 2 outdoor regulation fields
  • Indoor batting cages — 3 lanes
  • Pitching machines & lanes
  • Tournaments, showcases & clinics
04 / SOFTBALL
SOFTBALL
Two outdoor regulation fields with dedicated hitting and fielding zones. Built for travel teams, tournaments, clinics, and individual training year-round.
  • 2 outdoor regulation fields
  • Dedicated hitting & fielding zones
  • Travel team tournaments
  • Clinics & individual training
Beyond The Game

FACILITY FEATURES

FEATURE / COURTS
4 FULL COURTS
Tournament-ready hardwood available for open play, league games, and private rentals. Reconfigurable for basketball, volleyball, and multi-sport events.
  • Open 5 AM – Midnight daily
  • Digital credential access
  • Private & team rentals
FEATURE / TURF
2 TURF FIELDS
Full indoor turf for football, 7v7 drills, combine prep, and speed training. Completely weather-independent for consistent year-round development.
  • Football, soccer & multi-sport
  • Speed & agility training
  • No weather cancellations
FEATURE / CAGES
BATTING CAGES
Three dedicated lanes for baseball and softball with pitching machines. Available for individual sessions, team rentals, and clinics.
  • 3 dedicated lanes
  • Pitching machines included
  • Individual & team sessions
